The house of good taste!
Feb 2026 • Couples
As soon as you enter the venue, as others claim, you feel transported to the beating heart of Hoi An. The atmosphere is intimate and attention to detail: evocative light effects created by colorful lanterns, wooden furnishings and a welcome that makes you feel immediately at home. 
You also find good taste in the choice of background music and then get to the main attraction.... the food! Dishes that reflect tradition with its authentic flavors and that pay tribute to Vietnamese culture. 
Highly recommended for those looking for a culinary and sensory experience in addition to the magical and intimate environment.
The place is perfect for both a romantic dinner and a quiet evening with friends. 
Highly recommended!
Thank you so much guys

Hai D
Thank you so much, Rosi 💛

Your words truly touched us. Reading that you felt transported to the heart of Hoi An from the moment you walked in is exactly the experience we hope to create for every guest. The lantern lights, the wooden details, the music, the atmosphere — we put a lot of heart into every small element, so it means a lot that you noticed.

And of course, we’re especially happy that the food lived up to the atmosphere. Honoring Vietnamese tradition and authentic flavors is at the core of Grandma’s Kitchen.

Thank you for recommending us for both romantic dinners and evenings with friends — that’s the perfect compliment.

We hope to welcome you again very soon for another culinary and sensory experience in Phu Quoc ✨
